text.card: A red giant 4,302 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.81 solar masses and 12.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,589 K at its surface.
